sam: Originating RC: rc-2026-03-21f (tag rc-f21, build 955). Artifacts pushed to registry:redwood/inference:rc-f21 and s3://ci/rc-f21/. Requesting ops pin, KV warm, and quiet window 21:45-22:45 UTC. Proposing safety-shim (traffic roll-back latch) and deadman-service monitor.

deploy-bot: [CI] RC created rc-f21 (build 955). Artifacts uploaded. KV warm queued id=kv-955.

nina: Staging smoke passed. Small variance on long-tail prompts, added an eval tolerance. Model team pinned model v2.4.5-rc0 (quant=q4f16-2026-03).

diego: Rollback snippet (kept handy):
```
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:stable-2026-03-12 -n prod
# flip traffic shim back
curl -X POST "$DEPLOY_API/traffic/shim/reset" -d '{"target":"stable"}'
# deploy-bot rollback
deploy-bot rollback --rc rc-f21 --reason "auto-rollback"
```

ops-sheriff: I'll be primary for 21:45 window. Deadman set: auto-cut if errors >1% for 5m or GPU OOM. I'll be at console 21:35 UTC.

deploy-bot: [kv-warm] warming ~950k keys, threads=7
[log] 50% complete...
[log] completed in 2m 30s, cache 1.0GB

sam: Canary plan: 0.5% for 12m -> 5% for 20m -> 25% for 20m -> final promote. Thresholds: p95 < 165ms, errors < 0.7%, token-cost delta < 5%. Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/rc-f21. Ops watch GPU mem and autoscaler.

deploy-bot: [deploy] initiating canary rc-f21 -> prod at 2026-03-21T21:45:10Z (0.5%). Initial metrics: p95=136ms, errors=0.06%, cpu=50%, gpu=41%.

nina: Holding 12m. No anomaly. Proceed to 5%.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 5% complete at 2026-03-21T21:58:25Z. Monitoring.

diego: Noting a small token-cost uptick (~3%) at 5% from longer completions on a prompt family; within tolerance.

ops-sheriff: All clear in my watch. Approving step to 25% after 20m.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% started at 2026-03-21T22:20:40Z.

sam: Metrics stable at 25% (p95=148ms, errors=0.12%). Proceeding to promote and pin artifacts now.

deploy-bot: [deploy] promoting rc-f21 -> 100% at 2026-03-21T22:36:05Z. Final snapshot: p95=150ms, errors=0.11%, token-cost uplift=3.4%, cpu=62%, gpu=49%.

release-coordinator: Promotion complete. Release notes updated and release email queued. Locking rc-2026-03-21f as promoted. Will open follow-up if customers report regressions.

sam: Thanks all  recording this thread in the release docket and closing. :tada:
